steps.title: After king Thordan appears
steps.rule: Go to 4m north of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

steps.title: After wrath of the Heavens cast starts
steps.cue: Wrath of the Heavens cast starts
steps.rule: Go to 3m north of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LiquidHeaven).

MainTank.rule: When Tethered includes R1 and Lightning includes M1, go to the south-east wall; when Tethered leaves out R1 and Lightning includes M1, go to the north-west wall; when Tethered leaves out R1 and Lightning leaves out M1, go to the south-east wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When DragonBearing is north and Lightning leaves out R2, go to the south-west wall; when DragonBearing is west and Lightning leaves out R2, go to the north wall; when DragonBearing is east and Lightning leaves out R2, go to the south wall; when DragonBearing is east and Lightning includes R2, go to the south-west wall.

CasterDps.rule: When DragonBearing is north and Defamation leaves out R2, go to the south-east wall; when DragonBearing is west and Defamation leaves out R2, go to the north-east wall; when DragonBearing is east and Defamation leaves out R2, go to the south-west wall; when DragonBearing is east and Defamation includes R2, go to the north-east wall.
